changes: Inventory-only critic dispatch and both prompt modes use an authenticated completeness responsibility without topology implementation prerequisites. New runs reject stale epoch or wave dispatch before publication. Historical envelopes select their original authenticated dispatch. Canonical agent templates receive narrow manifest-semantic certification coverage. Incremental eligibility consumes the same registered selected responsibility, with an authenticated marker preserving pre-marker historical calculations. The required heartbeat fixture now allows descendant startup before its max deadline while retaining cleanup checks.
usage: Begin a current REVIEW inventory and dispatch proof-or-stop-review-topology-critic after required lanes finish; use the ordinary signed reviewer and inventory critic commands. Redispatch after an inventory epoch or wave changes.
expectedOutcome: A valid OPEN inventory accepts an independent completeness critic without an implementer-specific business commit, while topology authority and stale-context refusal remain enforced.
actualTranscript: Current built CLI dispatch emits the inventory-completeness contract. Real A/B historical dispatch and stable pre-marker eligibility probes pass: repeated inventory semantics no longer cause false FULL_ROLE_CONTRACT_CHANGED, and old signed envelopes remain verifiable within their recorded scope. Full/incremental and handler regressions passed; the full heartbeat smoke prints validate-progress-heartbeat smoke passed. Canonical gate receipts and genuine host review records provide separate completion evidence.
outcomeDiff: No difference in the tested supported inventory and topology boundary cases.
limitations: Pre-field records with unreconstructible original intent references (ordering, duplicates, or unprotected-story references absent from stored scope) fail closed. New critic runs in legacy-full-context mode also require a fresh responsibility-bearing dispatch; the CLI returns an actionable redispatch refusal. The original dynamic real-Story eligibility probe removes the target false reason but its historical control becomes stale after approved scope/task changes; a preserved pre-fix signed fixture separately proves targeted GREEN and historical compatibility. Optional topology smoke has an unchanged baseline transition-output assertion failure in retained paired logs. Historical scope/material drift is not waived.
pitfalls: Real independent review found full-envelope topology output leakage, stale dispatch reuse and historical latest-dispatch invalidation; scoped repairs now cover both producer modes and exact historical verification. PRE_CERT also exposed a missing canonical template path classification. Inventory completeness is not topology proof or TEST authority. Final native Round3 found a default-topology comparison in incremental eligibility; selected registered semantics now flow through producer and historical verifier. Required validation also exposed missing Lab build and a pre-existing700ms max-watchdog startup race reproduced on main; existing Lab was built and only the fixture timing relationship was corrected. One validation attempt had no admissible result because repair metadata changed HEAD while it ran; keep final validation source and metadata frozen.
